review_reference: UNSIGNED DRAFT: awaits the owner's signature of 0168 and 0169 and of runtime-grants.sql at the sha256s in files (numbers provisional, given at merge after 0152-0154 and the Release D department files cut before them). ED-1 Emergency department board and triage (Release D, the department sprint the owner approved on 25 November 2026), built at the recommended option of each open question, not yet answered by the owner: Q-ED-1 A (an ED patient is a row of the live waiting list plus an ED record), Q-ED-2 A (0169: the front desk arrives and sees the board without the complaint, nurses also triage, clinicians and doctors also record the disposition), Q-ED-3 A (an emergency search's patient may be put on the board while the member's own break-glass grant for them is active; Rahman and the DPO review this basis before 0168 is signed), Q-ED-4 A (a complaint of 1-120 characters, never shown to the front desk, never in an audit row), Q-ED-5 A (two-step disposition), Q-ED-6 A (admission requests kept on the ED record until wards ship), Q-ED-7 A (no new write basis). The board reuses 0135's live five-level triage scale, which the clinical lead must sign off before real patients use it. ehr-api's ED_BOARD_ENABLED stays off in production until the clinical lead's checklist and the owner's go-live. runtime-grants.sql is Release E's signed file (49b378f5..., signed 25 November 2026 with 0152 and 0153) plus 0168's block; 0169 adds no grant. Releases after 0001-0153 (Release E, live since 25 November 2026 17:04 UTC at 0cfddcc9). After the independent agent review the confirmed findings were fixed in 0168 (hid-system#337): a waiting-list guard (0135's update is refused for a row with an open or decided ED record, 409 VISIT_QUEUE_ON_ED_BOARD), cancel of an arrival moved from the outpatient waiting list puts that row back as it was, sent_to_outpatients clears the assignee, "left today" is the Lagos day the record left, and the visit link also accepts EHR-C1's open visit of the arrival's Lagos day. After the re-check, the kill switch: while ED_BOARD_ENABLED is off, ehr-api sends the waiting list's changes through 0168's new ehr.visit_queue_ed_board_off_update (0135's update, md5-pinned, under the board's marker; when the row is updated its open or decided ED record closes with a closed_on_waiting_list event and an audit row with boardOff true) and shows no ED record on the waiting list, so a board patient's row is never stuck while the board is off; while the flag is on nothing changes and the guard applies. 0168 now has 18 functions (13 SECURITY DEFINER); runtime-grants.sql grants the new function to hid_ehr_runtime only.
